meta.title: MCP Question Bank — Chapter 4: Client Concepts (multi-select)
meta.revision: v2.1 (curated 2026-09-12, 200 items, verified against the 2026-07-28 specification)

questions.question: Which client behaviours does the elicitation spec require? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Let the user review and modify form responses before they are sent
Make clear which server is requesting the information
Pre-fetch the URL to check it is reachable before showing it to the user
Show the full URL and get explicit consent before opening a URL-mode link
Strip the requestState before displaying the request, to avoid leaking state

questions.explanation: A, B and C are MUSTs for clients. Clients MUST NOT automatically pre-fetch the URL or any of its metadata, and requestState is simply echoed back untouched rather than displayed or edited.

questions.question: Which rules govern requestState? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Integrity protection makes a state value single-use by construction
Clients MUST NOT inspect, parse or modify it
Clients MUST include one on the retry even if the server did not send one
Servers MUST treat a returned value as attacker-controlled input
Servers SHOULD bind it to the principal, a short TTL and the originating request

questions.explanation: The client echoes it opaquely; the server protects it because it travelled through a possibly malicious client. If no requestState was sent, the client MUST NOT invent one. TTL and binding bound replay but do not guarantee single use, which servers must enforce themselves.
